faq.question: Can I convert WEBP to JPG?
faq.answer: Yes. Your WEBP image will be converted to JPG with high quality.

faq.question: Why convert WEBP to JPG?
faq.answer: WEBP is not supported by every app, while JPG is easier to share and display across devices.

faq.answer: No. JPG does not support transparency. Transparent areas become a solid background.

faq.answer: Yes. JPG files are smaller and widely supported for email, websites, and quick sharing.
